During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|intergalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] between [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' pp. XIII</ref> the Vong attacked the [[Cyrillia system/Legends|Cyrillia system]] within [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]]. The battle took place some time between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] and the Vong reached the [[Star system/Legends|system]] by traveling from the Vong controlled world of [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] which they had reached after a previous [[Battle of the Prindaar system|attack]] on the [[Prindaar system/Legends|Prindaar system]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on the Cyrillia system was first shown in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book released in [[2009]] and written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. The attack is not mentioned in the text of the book but is shown on a map detailing conflicts in the galaxy between 26 ABY and 27 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War, which was called "collapse of [[Core Worlds/Legends|the Core]]". No information is given about the outcome of the attack although a separate map shows Cyrillia was under Vong control by 27 ABY.<ref name="EA" />
